text:
maria: Who's up for a quick boulder+run swap today? 30 min boulder session at the wall then 20 min treadmill intervals. 12:15 start. Bring chalk. :chalk:
aj: Love this. Prefer 12:45 tho. Can make 12:15 if mostly bouldering. Level: V2-V3. @liam you in?
liam: In for 12:45. If we need a spotter count me. Also can bring protein bars.
sam: I'm late today, can join 5pm session? otherwise put my name down if you need an extra spot.
coachbot: Coachbot schedule update: 12:15 - 4 spots, 12:45 - 6 spots, 17:00 - 5 spots. To sign up react :white_check_mark: or reply with `swap`.
tara: Quick poll — what's everyone's preferred warmup? foam roll / tempo jog / fingerboard 5 min. I vote tempo jog.
aj: tempo jog + mobilizer. Also re: treadmill intervals — does `2 min @8.5mph / 1 min walk x5` sound good?
maria: Yup. aj that plan works. I'm bringing a crash pad for low falls. @sam we'll try to save a spot at 17:00.
liam: :thumbsup: signed up for 12:45. Anyone want to carpool from office? I'm on floors 5/6, leaving at 12:30.
sam: I'm at desk 3B, can give a lift after standup at 12:10 if you can do 12:15 ppl.
maria: Standing meeting makes me 5 min late either way — fine to start when everyone's there. See you all.
aj: Also quick tip from last time: tape the tips of the index on your left hand, it helped my crimps.
tara: Bringing a small first-aid kit and some tape. If anyone wants the interval plan in text:
```
Intervals x5:
2:00 run @8.5mph
1:00 walk @3.5mph
Repeat 5x, cool down 5 min jog
```
liam: Perfect. I'll stash a couple of extra chalk balls in my bag.
coachbot: Reminder: please log attendance with `swap` so we don't overbook. Have fun and stay safe! :running_shirt_with_sash:
